digest.component_or_area: MCP HTTP edge routing and TLS termination
propositions: The documented MCP client URL with trailing slash (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp/) returns HTTP 307 redirecting to plaintext http://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp, exposing bearer PAT tokens on the wire.

nginx prefix location /mcp with URI-preserving proxy_pass diverges from the documented exact-match pattern, causing Starlette redirect_slashes to emit the 307 when the app is mounted at /mcp without trailing slash.

uvicorn's ProxyHeadersMiddleware defaults FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS to 127.0.0.1, causing it to reject X-Forwarded-Proto headers from nginx arriving via the Docker bridge gateway, making scheme-derived URLs render as http://.
The 443 server carries no Strict-Transport-Security header, providing no browser backstop against HTTPS-to-HTTP downgrades.

The blue-green deployment path (autodeploy.sh mcp_run_new) must pass FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS='*' via docker run -e flag to match the compose service environment, ensuring consistent trusted-proxy behavior across all deployment modes.
